description: Webgrip's own packages: minor, patch, digest and pin updates of anything Webgrip publishes (Harbor's webgrip project, ghcr.io/webgrip, @webgrip npm packages, webgrip repositories as actions or git tags) share one branch of their own that opens without a tick, skips the release-age soak and merges itself on green. Webgrip's release pipeline is the gate for these and semantic versioning is ours to keep, so a soak only delays them, and a separate branch keeps a red third-party update from holding them back. Majors open their pull request without a tick and wait for a person to merge it: a major is ours to break, so it never merges itself, but nobody should have to ask for it either.

packageRules.description: Harbor's webgrip project holds only Webgrip's images; its proxy projects (dockerhub, ghcr, quay) are third-party and stay out.

A major of Webgrip's own packages opens its pull request without a dashboard tick and never merges itself. The approval part ticks every major and this part comes after it, so this rule lifts that tick for Webgrip's own packages only; the major's own branch, commit type and zero soak stay as the earlier parts set them.
